findings.summary: Round 3 verified, no open defect: F4/F5/F6 repaired in src/control-plane/projection-readiness-evidence-generation.js. Every own key's value (including observation-time keys whose text is omitted) is walked through the shared trace and the record returns REJECTED at the first rejected slot; arrays return at the first rejected index and accept non-enumerable data indexes as copyDenseOwnDataArray does; DIGEST_MAX_DEPTH is the normalizer cap minus one so field-relative depth 14 is COMPLETE and 15 is INCOMPLETE exactly where normalizeProjectionReadinessOwnDataGraph fails closed. Re-attacked with the six round-2 aliasing shapes plus Date-under-observedAt inside an array element, a symbol key inside a container under enteredAt and a non-enumerable observedAt slot (all INCOMPLETE, plain twins COMPLETE, {a:1,observedAt:5} still equals {a:1,observedAt:9}), a frozen membership root with a Date under createdAt (rejection replayed from the cache), a 5,000,000-length sparse array (rejected in 11 ms) and a differential fuzz of 20,000 random shapes through nodeEvidence plus 20,000 through the cached membershipPublication path (deep- and shallow-frozen roots, digested twice): 40,000 agreements with the strict normalizer's verdict, 0 false acceptances, 0 false rejections, 0 cache mismatches, no exception. Residuals that are not defects: Reflect.ownKeys is not try/catch-wrapped but only proxies can make it throw and they are rejected first; -0 and 0 share a key (harmless).

Cost note carried and now documented by the author (dep-scope section 6.3 and the LIVE receipt caveat): the round-3 digest costs 43.8 us per evaluation on production-shaped seam records with the membership digest cached versus 23.2 us for the review-1 candidate and a 180.5 us normalize miss with fresh identities; unchanged from round 2, reuse and builds-per-read bar unaffected, owner build CPU unaffected. All four receipt files, readiness-per-change-reuse and the three coupled-pair witnesses re-run green on this candidate (322/537/35/38/26/104/15/146).

Carried forward unchanged: control-plane-readiness-stored-snapshot-reuse.js getFresherStoredReadinessSnapshot overrides the top-level membershipPublication with the fresh diagnostics while keeping the stored core and dimensions; with the version-stamped memo the macrotask window between a publication apply and its listener becomes mixed-freshness (top-level at the new epoch, core at the old epoch) where it was consistently stale before. Already recorded by the author as a separate owner.
